_comment: Three rounds of one race at two call sites whose files share two modules equally, a logger and a prompt module, and whose findings name neither. Modelled on a group-call PR whose gate keyed this class to the logger by the alphabet. `sources` keeps the classifier off the disk.

findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recheck the room after the await**

The room state is read, then the join is written after an await, so a hang-up in between wins the race and the join lands on a room that has ended.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Relay turns in the order they arrived**

Two relays started concurrently interleave their writes, so the later turn can overtake the earlier one; the same race as the room join.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Revalidate the call before starting the bridge**

The bridge starts after an awaited setup step with nothing rechecking that the call is still live, so an ended call gets a bridge.
